action.name: Taunt
entries: Tem launches an infuriating barrage of insults at a creature she can see within 60 feet of her. If the target can hear Tem, it must succeed on a {@dc 12} Wisdom saving throw or have disadvantage on attack rolls until the end of its next turn.

bonus.name: Elusive
entries: Tem takes the {@action Disengage} or {@action Hide} action.

rows: Spellcasting. Tem learns another 1st-level spell: {@spell faerie fire}.
Spellcasting. Tem gains one 1st-level spell slot. She also learns another 1st-level spell: {@spell goodberry}.

Ability Score Improvement. Tem's Wisdom score increases by 2, raising the modifier by 1, so increase the following numbers by 1: her spell save DC and the bonus to hit of spell attacks; her Wisdom saving throw bonus; her {@skill Insight}, {@skill Medicine}, and {@skill Perception} bonuses; her passive {@skill Perception} score; and the DC of her Taunt action. Spellcasting. Tem learns another cantrip: {@spell mending}.

Proficiency Bonus. Tem's proficiency bonus increases by 1, so increase the following numbers by 1: her spell save DC and the bonus to hit of her spell attacks, the bonuses in the Saving Throws and Skills entries, and the bonuses to hit of her weapon attacks, and the DC of her Taunt action.
Potent Cantrips. Tem adds her Wisdom modifier to the damage she deals with any cantrip.
